Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ESIC Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) position is scheduled for 12th August 2026. Candidates should report between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ESIC for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ESIC has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria include a Postgraduate degree in Clinical Embryology with 3 years of experience, or a Ph.D. in Clinical Embryology/ART with 1 year of experience, among other options detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the candidates applying for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Embryologist (Scientist Gr-I) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be appointed at Level 10, with a Grade Pay of Rs 5400, along with applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for different categories?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs 500 for General/OBC candidates. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report to the venue on the specified date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Faridabad, Haryana. The exact venue details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any relaxation in the age limit for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation details. Candidates belonging to reserved categories are advised to refer to the official notification for any applicable age relaxation rules.
